title: A little more Vegas, a little more machinery
summary: Lucky Five gets a proper upright cabinet, illuminated artwork and mechanical sound feedback.
notes: Spin a chrome-trimmed machine with recessed reels, a sloped button deck and a working beacon.
Hear the lever latch, ratcheting reels, individual stops, payout coins and winning bell through the sound-effects controls.
Watch the lever spring back and the beacon celebrate a winning result.
